posts.name: TEKKEN
posts.text:
A #TEKKEN8 patch will drop on Nov 11 at 23:00 CET | Nov 11 at 14:00 PST.
This patch intends to support Roger Jr. Early Access, correct unintended behavior, and update content on the TEKKEN SHOP.

*Details of the update will be provided in the patch notes on the day of release.
